messages:
devin: Heads up — EU warm pool failing after ephemeral KMS routing change at 07:05. GPU joins timing out and queuing.
marie: seeing keystore-proxy queueing + NATGW conntrack spikes :grimacing: logs attached.
alejandro: what routing change? thought it was just TTL on audit sink.
samira: new auditfold endpoint was deployed; it added an extra auth header validation that increases p95 on the keystore path.
devin: keystore-proxy retries on 401/5xx -> retry storm -> conntrack exhaustion -> warmup failures.
sre-bot: Alert: keystore-proxy latency p50=1.2s p95=2.6s EU region (07:06).
ops: initiating rollback of auditfold routing (starting).
marie: can we canary 1% and add fail-open for ephemeral keys while we investigate? minimal impact on warmup is priority.
alejandro: rollback in progress, ETA ~3m.
samira: short mitigation: add egress allowlist for auditfold IPs to bypass proxy (temp).
devin: bypass reduces auth checks and increases audit sampling costs, but may restore warmups quickly.
ops: rollback complete, warmups recovering — join latency trending down.
marie: warmup success rate ~98% last 5m, token queueing dropped.
alejandro: follow-ups: enforce canary rollout, create IAM role boundary for the new audit principal, and implement keystore circuit-breaker to avoid retry storms.
samira: I'll open a runbook PR with remediation steps + commands for oncall.
devin: quick commands if we need the temp allowlist:
kubectl -n infra patch configmap keystore-egress --patch '{"data":{"egress_allowlist":"auditfold-eu:443"}}'
# apply simple circuit-breaker config map
kubectl -n infra apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: keystore-circuit-breaker
data:
  failure_threshold: "5"
  window_seconds: "30"
EOF
marie: also need to measure NAT GW conntrack and egress cost delta in billing — filing follow-up.
ops-runbook-bot: Created incident 2026-03-23-001 assigned to oncall (ops); runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ephemeral-kms-routing
samira: filed INFRA-8472 (canary + IAM boundary + circuit-breaker).
devin: keep EU audit routing disabled until canary + CB verified.
marie: :thumbsup:
